en.headline: Woman, 67, arrested over HK$4.3 million rental crypto scam
en.dek: Police say the suspect posed as a tenant, prepaid rent to win trust, then supplied phones pre-loaded with fake investment app links that transferred control of victims’ wallets.
body: A 67-year-old local woman was arrested on Monday on suspicion of obtaining property by deception after two property owners lost a total of about HK$4.3 million in an alleged cryptocurrency investment scam, West District police said.

According to Senior Inspector Kwok Yu-kan of the district’s Regional Crime Unit, the two victims had posted advertisements to rent out a parking space and a flat. The suspect contacted them posing as a prospective tenant and prepaid rent to build trust.

She then persuaded the owners to join a purported high-return investment scheme and provided free mobile phones. The phones already contained a legitimate-looking cryptocurrency app that had been pre-configured with false links, transferring control of the victims’ electronic wallets without their knowledge. Funds deposited under the suspect’s instructions were quickly moved away.

Police identified the woman as a key member of a criminal group after reviewing extensive CCTV footage and intelligence. She was arrested at her residence and remains under investigation. Officers do not rule out further arrests. Police advised the public never to hand over bank or wallet credentials, and never to use phones or apps supplied by strangers when renting out property.

zh.headline: 六旬婦扮租客誘投資加密貨幣 呃兩業主430萬被捕
zh.dek: 西區警方指67歲女子假扮租客預支租金博信任，再提供預載虛假連結的手機，令兩名業主共損失約430萬元。
body: 西區警區重案組周一拘捕一名67歲本地女子，涉嫌以欺騙手段取得財產。兩名業主分別出租車位及單位時，合共損失約430萬元。
西區重案組第一隊高級督察郭愉勤表示，兩名事主刊登出租廣告後，騙徒主動聯絡並假扮租客，甚至預支租金以博取信任。其後遊說事主參與聲稱高回報的加密貨幣投資，並免費提供已下載投資應用程式的手提電話。
該應用程式表面正常，但已被預先設定虛假連結，令事主在不知情下將電子錢包控制權交給對方。事主按指示存入資金後，款項即被轉走，直至無法提款才發現受騙。
警方翻查大量閉路電視及情報分析後鎖定該名女子為犯罪集團骨幹，周一在其住所將她拘捕。案件仍在調查，不排除再有人被捕。警方呼籲市民放租時切勿輕信主動提及高回報投資的陌生人，亦不要使用他人提供的手機或預先安裝的應用程式。
